summary: WARN: 148 claim records; displayed empirical numbers reconcile, while replay/protocol/source provenance and several implementation or threshold mappings are outside the declared evidence.

details.paper_title: Estimation- and Feasibility-Aware Continuous Capture and Momentum-Consistent Detumbling with a Free-Floating Single Arm

mismatches.paper_text: fixed 20 mm tool/interface geometry
mismatches.details: No geometry model or T_FE is declared. Recorded offsets are 19.7569 and 19.8 mm; these can be compatible with a nominal 20 mm dimension, but the quantity has no unique frame/dimension mapping here. This is not a demonstrated number error.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Specify the exact 20 mm dimension and include its model/transform definition.

mismatches.paper_text: After locking, position and attitude limits are 0.5 mm and 0.1 degree.
mismatches.details: The declared mission/run configurations expose capture/performance thresholds, but not these post-lock safety limits. Observed small errors do not establish the configured guard limits.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Include the original postgrasp/interface threshold configuration.

mismatches.paper_text: A 0.25 s history stores the contact/process mode used over each past interval.
mismatches.details: History length and process-mode replay behavior are not exposed in declared configs/traces.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Include estimator source or a bounded-history contract and raw check.

mismatches.paper_text: Batches are sorted by measurement time; duplicate and older out-of-order samples are rejected rather than retrospectively assimilated.
mismatches.details: No original packet/rejection stream or estimator source is declared. Causality/rejection cannot be certified from error outputs alone.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Audit archived estimator source and packet-level decisions.

mismatches.paper_text: development reduced the free-motion acceleration process densities from 0.03/0.2 to 0.003 m/s^(3/2) and 0.02 rad/s^(3/2)
mismatches.details: New noisy process densities are exact. The old S01 effective config is not supplied, and generic mission defaults need not equal its noisy overrides. The old 0.03/0.2 cannot be mapped independently.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Supply archived S01 effective configuration.

mismatches.paper_text: Capture tests use the raw timestamped estimate and its covariance, never the smoother reference state.
mismatches.details: Separate estimate/reference arrays exist, but guard input identity requires source or call-level records.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Include archived guard source and call-level records.

mismatches.paper_text: Progress demand is filtered through three positive first-order stages with a 0.30 s time constant.
mismatches.details: Time constant matches; number/positivity of stages is not exposed by the allowed new-run inputs.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Include filter source or internal stage traces.

mismatches.paper_text: The bounded plan allows at most two candidate versions, eight development attempts and four final seen regressions.
mismatches.details: The eight supplied attempts do not exceed the manuscript budget. However inherited effective cap fields are 6/16; no frozen n209 budget contract/ledger maps them to the stated 8+4 policy. This is a provenance ambiguity, not a demonstrated count violation.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Supply authoritative frozen cap contract/ledger and explain inherited fields.

mismatches.paper_text: The planned independent design has six physical clusters, three fixed sensor seeds and paired B0/B1 methods, followed by six prespecified B2 and two fine-step trials.
mismatches.details: Clearly presented as an unexecuted plan; its frozen seed/distribution contract and prespecification are not among allowed inputs.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Include the planned protocol contract; retain NOT_EVALUATED qualification.

mismatches.paper_text: We provide conditional geometric and momentum arguments, archived-source dual replay, and an explicit account of unsupported claims.
mismatches.details: No validation.json, replay output, original packets/events or archived source contents are declared. The paper table labels all replays PENDING_OR_FAIL. This audit cannot substantiate completion/identity; abstract phrasing may imply more than the displayed status.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Provide replay results in a fresh audit, or qualify the abstract as replay procedure/status pending verification.

mismatches.paper_text: Source and configuration hashes, full packets, references, covariance, QP data, events, actuator inputs, plant trajectories and resource logs are saved for every new attempt, including early failures.
mismatches.details: Eight config/trace sets support trajectories/reference/covariance/actuation presence, including early failure. Additional asserted packet/event/QP/resource files are outside the input set.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Provide complete raw artifact manifest and claimed streams.

mismatches.paper_text: Old and revised estimator velocity error norms on the same archived packets, without a new plant rollout.
mismatches.details: PNG norms/units and 1-7 s alignment agree, but raw packet identities and reanalysis source are not declared; identical packets/no new rollout cannot be certified from output errors alone.
mismatches.recommended_fix: Include immutable packet hashes and reanalysis provenance.
